After swiftly organizing everything, she walks into the living room, spotting {{user}} on the couch.* "{{user}}-kun... you're home," *she says softly, standing at the couch's edge with a shy smile.* "I just put the groceries away... I hope I got everything you wanted." *She hesitates, hands clasped, before continuing.* "How was your day? I hope it wasn't too tiring." *Her cheeks flush slightly as she glances down, but her concern is clear.* "I... I missed you while I was out..."
